channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Off-duty Hanoi nurse saves security guard after cardiac arrest at supermarket
item.description: A nurse from Hanoi’s Bach Mai Hospital resuscitated a 59-year-old security guard who suffered cardiac arrest at a supermarket in the capital this week, the hospital said on Friday.

item.title: Vietnam’s xiangqi master Lai Ly Huynh reaches Wuyang Cup semi-finals after defeating 3 Chinese players
item.description: Vietnam’s Lai Ly Huynh secured a place in the semi-finals of the Wuyang Cup after defeating China’s Liu Zijian in the final round of Group B at the invitational xiangqi (Chinese chess) tournament on Friday.

item.title: Vietnam women’s football team departs for 2026 AFC Asian Cup in Australia
item.description: Vietnam’s women’s national football team departed for Australia on Friday to compete in the 2026 AFC Women’s Asian Cup finals, which will determine qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup.

item.title: Tram derails in central Milan leaving two dead, 40 injured
item.description: MILAN -- Two people were killed and around 40 injured when a tram derailed in central Milan on Friday, a spokesperson for local firefighters said.

item.title: Bolivian military plane crash kills 15, scatters cash cargo
item.description: LA PAZ -- Fifteen people were killed and at least 30 more were injured on Friday evening after a Bolivian Air Force Hercules aircraft carrying new banknotes from the country's central bank crashed onto a busy avenue amid inclement weather in the city of El Alto, near Bolivia's capital La Paz, according to television reports.

item.title: Vietnamese teacher temporarily removed after allegedly forcing student to ‘lick the ground’
item.description: An elementary school teacher in Phu Tho Province, northern Vietnam has been temporarily reassigned after allegations surfaced online that she forced students to lick the ground during class.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City to roll out 169 electric buses in push for greener transport
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City will launch nine electric bus routes with 169 VinBus vehicles seating 30–60 passengers from early March, replacing diesel-powered buses as part of its transition toward greener public transport.

item.title: Paramount to buy Warner Bros Discovery in $110 billion deal as Netflix bows out of race
item.description: Warner Bros Discovery has agreed to be acquired by Paramount Skydance in a $110 billion deal, ending a high-stakes bidding war after Netflix walked away from its agreement with the HBO Max owner.

item.title: Man dies after injury in village wrestling festival in Hanoi
item.description: A man died after being injured while competing in a traditional wrestling match at a village festival in Hanoi, local authorities said on Friday.

item.title: New Pokemon titles on horizon as 30th anniversary approaches
item.description: PARIS, France -- Pikachu and friends are set to return to consoles in two new games next year, the Pokemon Company said Friday, as it celebrated 30 years of the monster-collecting franchise.
